blueprint.summary: Tampa Bay Buccaneers hold $15.05M in 2026 OverTheCap space ($15.05M effective) and -$6.06M projected for 2027.
blueprint.executiveSummary: Jason Licht and the Buccaneers front office hold $15.05M in gross 2026 cap space ($15.05M effective), while 2027 currently projects at -$6.06M over an estimated $327M cap ceiling. Rolling unused 2026 cap space 1-for-1 under CBA Article 13 ($8M–$12M target) helps manage scheduled cap escalations for Tristan Wirfs, Baker Mayfield, Chris Godwin Jr., Antoine Winfield Jr..

strategicPillars.title: 1. CBA Article 13 Rollover Bridge ($8M–$12M Target vs. -$6.06M 2027 Projection)
strategicPillars.detail: Unused 2026 cap space carries over dollar-for-dollar into 2027, buffering Tampa Bay's projected 2027 ledger without forcing premature void-year restructures.

strategicPillars.title: 2. Prorated Base Salary & Option-Bonus Architecture
strategicPillars.detail: Converting base salary or option bonuses spreads cap charges across up to 5 years (including void years) while preserving weekly in-season flexibility.
